Interview Shortlisted applicants will be invited for an interview (face-to-face or by phone) organized by the Guanghua School of Management in December, March and April. Competitive applicants will receive an offer of admission by email within 2 weeks after the interview, as well as a hardcopy admission letter to follow by mail in late June each year. 3. materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.English proficiency test certificate 80 or above for TOEFL; 6.0 or above for IELTS; or other certificates which can prove that English is his/her native language or the working language at college. 6.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 7.Personal statement Around 1000 words for Master candidates in Chinese (Chinese-taught programs) or English(English-taught programs).Study and work experience, academic research achievement, planned research proposal should be included, and individual development obje 8.Proof of Working Experience

requirements.text: Obtain master degree; Non-Chinese citizen with at least three years' working experience.
